name: r07_ring_of_holes_remains
why: Six holes on a Ø80 circle, and the outer cylinder grows from 100 to 140. The bolt circle is a mating dimension: it is what must line up with the flange on the other side, and it has nothing to do with the outer diameter.
intent_why: the bolt circle is at Ø80 because the flange it mates with says so, not the part. Thickening the outside does not touch it: the six centres stay where they are.

after.tolerance_why: the bounding box of a cylinder is read with GetExtremePoint
six holes plus the outer cylinder, which is at (0,0): 40*cos(60) = 20 exactly
